basis: Lilly if-bewitched rule: witchcraft requires affliction of Ascendant, its lord or Moon by the lord of the twelfth; here expressly absent. Saturn on 6th cusp = natural disease; Moon applying after Saturn opposition to Ascendant lord strong above earth = recovery direction, not malefice.
prediction_text: Not bewitched. The suspicion arises only from the Moon going to opposition of Saturn with those planets in the sixth and twelfth, but neither the Ascendant, its lord, nor the Moon is afflicted by the lord of the twelfth, so witchcraft is not the cause. The illness is a natural Saturnine sickness (Saturn on the cusp of the sixth). After her opposition of Saturn the Moon applies to the lord of the Ascendant, who is above the earth and ascending towards the meridian, so the patient is not under a witch's power and should mend rather than be destroyed by sorcery.
timing: Day scale: improvement to be looked for as the Moon completes her application to the lord of the Ascendant, in the days immediately following the opposition to Saturn
